title: Two Lines Set Side by Side
subtitle: 比较与对比 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 比较与对比（语言与思维·比较与对比）
meta: 主题语境：比较与对比（语言与思维·比较与对比）　|　核心词汇：comparison　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 comparison 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 my teacher ① made a comparison between two translations of the same line, and she said the making was the whole of the reading. The ② comparison, meaning the placing side by side and not the numbers, took one lesson and stayed open; comparison, she said, is the only thing in a reading that is judged by how little it concludes.

Every ③ comparison in that report had the same margin, and the ④ comparison at the end, meaning the one she kept for the last chapter and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever copied twice. Comparison, my mother said, is nine parts margin and one part somebody willing to conclude; my teacher said the not concluding is the part that fills the margin.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the comparison was the whole of the poem, meaning the likening and not the numbers. The ⑥ comparison, meaning the likening and not any of that, is the only thing in a poem that everybody feels and nobody explains; comparison, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a placing side by side and a likening. She said the likening is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ comparison had become a line in a review, and the review had become an argument about the margin. The ⑧ comparison of the whole thing, my teacher wrote in July, was one lesson and thirty years of placing side by side; comparison, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to conclude. He said the concluding was never mentioned.

The ⑨ comparison I remember is the one at the end, which she made in 1978 and is still described as the narrowest in the school. A ⑩ comparison, my mother said in 1980, is the only thing that improves by being copied; every comparison, she said, is a likening that has agreed to look like a margin. She said the likening was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 比较（指那次并置对照本身，与那些数字相对）
C. 固定搭配：make a comparison 进行比较
D. n. 比较（指那份报告里每一处）
E. n. 比较（指末尾那一处）
F. n. 比拟；比喻（修辞上的 likening）
G. n. 比较（指评论里提到的那一处）
H. n. 比较（抽象总称，比较这一做法）

items.q: made a comparison between two translations
The comparison, meaning the placing side by side
the comparison was the whole of the poem
the comparison had become a line in a review
The comparison of the whole thing
A comparison, my mother said in 1980

answers.why: make a comparison 意为“进行比较”，1964 年老师对同一行文字的两种译文作了比较。
comparison 意为“比较”，指那次并置对照本身而不是那些数字，它花了一节课，并且一直敞着没有收束。
comparison 指那份报告里每一处比较，每一处都留着同样的页边空白。
comparison 指末尾那一处（她留给最后一章的那一处），是唯一有人抄过两次的。
comparison 意为“比拟、比喻”，父亲说这个比拟就是那首诗的全部，指的是那一层比方而不是那些数字。
comparison 为修辞用法，指那一层比方而不是那些数字，是诗里人人感受得到、却无人解释的东西。
comparison 意为“比较”，指评论里提到的那一处，到 1972 年这次比较成了评论里的一行。
comparison 意为“比较”，老师七月写道，整件事的比较是一节课三十年的并置对照。
comparison 意为“比较”，我记得的是末尾那一处，她 1978 年作的，至今仍被说成全校最窄的。
comparison 为抽象总称，母亲说一次比较是唯一会因为被抄录而变好的东西。
